summary: Kyivstar Group Ltd., a DIFC-domiciled Ukrainian telecom operator listed on the NYSE, furnished a US-equivalent Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) covering its third-quarter 2026 earnings release, press release and investor presentation. Revenue rose 17.5% year over year to USD 349 million, EBITDA rose 10.3% to USD 189 million and diluted EPS was USD 0.36. Management raised its 2026 outlook to 15-17% USD revenue growth and 10-12% EBITDA growth. No transaction, stakeholder change or structural event is disclosed; the filing is a routine quarterly results announcement, so no deal terms or arbitrage angle apply.
